verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of API rate limits or of how limits scale across usage tiers. The available items cover per-second billing, cost estimates on model pages, and automatic infrastructure scaling. Autoscaling is about capacity, not published request limits, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits and how they scale across usage tiers before I hit them in production
